entries.name: A Familiar Face
entries.description: Someone in the opposing group is an old friend, rival, or lost family member of a party member.

entries.name: All that glitters
entries.description: A group is in possession of or seeking a powerful artifact or hidden treasure.

entries.name: Reinforcements Arrive
entries.description: More enemies or allies show up, changing the balance of power.

entries.name: Bargaining Chip
entries.description: Someone important is taken hostage or used as leverage, changing the nature of the encounter.

entries.name: Storm Incoming
entries.description: Dark clouds gather, strong winds pick up, and a storm is about to break. The encounter may be disrupted or changed due to weather.

entries.name: Dense Fog
entries.description: Visibility drops dramatically, making it harder to see who’s friend or foe. Beyond the max visual range, all vision-related checks have disadvantage.

entries.name: Tangled Roots Maze
entries.description: A dense thicket of mangrove roots forms a nearly impassable natural labyrinth, possibly home to predators or hidden treasures.

entries.name: Shifting Sandbar
entries.description: A temporary island of sand and mud that appears at low tide but vanishes when the tide rises.

entries.name: Brackish Water Pool
entries.description: A stagnant, algae-covered pool where something lurks beneath the surface.

entries.name: Bioluminescent Lagoon
entries.description: A section of water that glows faintly at night due to bioluminescent plankton, creating an eerie and mesmerizing atmosphere.

entries.name: Salt-Stained Dead Grove
entries.description: A section of the swamp where all the trees have died, leaving only ghostly white trunks standing in the water.

entries.name: Leech-Infested Bog
entries.description: A knee-deep pool covered in reeds, where anyone stepping in may emerge covered in blood-draining parasites. DC 10 Con save each round or lose 1 hp.

entries.name: Cave in the Roots
entries.description: A hidden cavern formed beneath the tangled roots of an ancient mangrove tree, possibly containing old bones, a lost treasure chest, or something worse.

entries.name: Old Shipwreck
entries.description: The ruined husk of a once-proud vessel, now half-sunken and broken apart by the mangrove roots growing through it. Could be a pirate ship, merchant vessel, or colonial warship.

entries.name: Abandoned Smuggler’s Den
entries.description: A small wooden outpost on stilts, long deserted but still containing hidden compartments with contraband.

entries.name: Ruined Stilt Village
entries.description: The remains of an old settlement built on wooden stilts, now half-collapsed and reclaimed by nature. Signs of a struggle still linger.

entries.name: Bridge to Nowhere
entries.description: A partially collapsed wooden bridge leading to a missing section, hinting at an old road swallowed by the swamp.

entries.name: Flooded Prison Cell
entries.description: A rusting iron cage barely visible beneath the water, its bars warped and broken. Who was once kept here?

entries.name: Fallen Lighthouse
entries.description: A ruined tower that once guided ships through the mangrove-lined waterways, now little more than rubble and overgrown vines.

entries.name: Overgrown Watchtower
entries.description: A crumbling wooden structure with faded colonial banners, still holding an old musket or spyglass inside.

entries.name: Shrine of the Swamp Spirits
entries.description: A small stone altar covered in offerings of shells, beads, and bones, dedicated to local swamp deities or spirits.

entries.name: Witch’s Hut
entries.description: A strange, crooked wooden house built above the water, covered in charms and talismans. A local healer or dangerous hermit might reside here.

entries.name: Cursed Totem Grove
entries.description: A circle of rotting wooden totems, depicting long-forgotten gods or monsters. Strange whispers fill the air.

entries.name: Skeleton Dock
entries.description: An ancient dock made of blackened wood and bones, long abandoned but eerily well-preserved.

entries.name: Driftwood Raft Village
entries.description: A nomadic settlement of scavengers living on rafts and floating platforms, wary of outsiders but open to trade.

entries.name: Sunken Battlefield
entries.description: A shallow stretch of water littered with rusting weapons, broken canoes, and bones from an old battle.

storm.name: Storm Rolls
storm.usage: Roll each round while the storm rages.

entries.name: Lightning
entries.description: DC 12 Dex save or take 2d6 damage while out of cover.

entries.name: Wind
entries.description: DC 12 Str save or be pushed 5 ft in a random direction.

entries.name: Rain
entries.description: DC 12 Wis save or the grip on your weapon is loosened: disadvantage on your next weapon attack.

entries.name: Thunder
entries.description: DC 12 Con save or be deafened for the duration of the round.
